decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of two years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (30061/PL/101B, 30061/PL/111, 30061/PL/112B, 30061/PL/113A, 30061/PL/114A, 30061/PL/115A, 30061/PL/116A, 30061/PL/117A, 30061/PL/118A, 30061/PL/119B, 30061/PL/120B, 30061/PL/121B, 30061/PL/122B, 30061/PL/123B, 30061/PL/124B, 30061/PL/125, 30061/PL/126B,0103498/HL/XX/XX/DR/E/630/1000/P6, 576.19.04 RevD, SS/017047-13/P1, SS/017047-12/P1, SS/017047-11/P1, SS/017047-10/P1, SS/017047-01/P1

Construction Logistics Plan dated 18th January 2013, Site Waste Management Plan, Bird Hazard Management Plan, Flood Risk and Water Management Statement, Noise Impact Assessment, Planning Statement, Design and Access Statement, Ecological Assessment, Air Quality Assessment, Transport Statement, External Lighting Strategy, Letter dated 17th December 2012 regarding lighting,
(submitted and approved with application 01321/N/P3)

 and Williams and Hill Delivery and Servicing plan dated October 2013, received 21/10/2013  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The boundary treatment shall be provided as specified prior to the occupation of the development.
Condition : 4 - Processing, packaging and storage of commercial goods activities shall not take place anywhere on the site except within buildings and approved cargo containers.

Condition : 5 - The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises as B1c, B2 and B8 Uses and shall not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 6 - Other than as specified in the application no fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the LPA.
Condition : 7 - The refuse storage shall be provided as specified prior to the occupation of the development.

Condition : 8 - The areas for the loading, unloading and turning of vehicles shall be provided as specified in the application and shall be retained for as long as the development remains in existence unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - The disabled access arrangements shall be provided as specified in the application prior to the occupation of the buildings and shall be retained for as long as the development remains in existence.

Condition : 10 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied:
a. The LPA shall be notified immediately if additional land contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the LPA for approval.  
b. The agreed scheme for decontamination, including amendments, must be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the LPA for approval.

Condition : 11 - During construction works an appropriate wheel-washing system shall be provided to remove mud, stones and any other extraneous materials from the wheels and chassis' of construction vehicles exiting the site and all loads of construction materials, excavation spoil or other such matter shall be fully covered in order to ensure that no material leaves the site attached to the vehicle which might subsequently be deposited on the highway. The exit from the wheel washing system shall be constructed from a hard, non-porous surfacing material and sited as far away from the exit to the highway as is possible given the constraints of the site and the surface shall be kept clean at all times.  Waste water discharged from the wheel washing system shall be stored and disposed of on site and shall not be discharged into the public sewerage system without prior removal of soil, stones and any other suspended material.  Suitable measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties shall also be provided and site lighting shall be designed, positioned and directed so as not to unnecessarily intrude on passing drivers on public highways and so as not to direct light into any windows of properties outside the site.  Start of works on site shall be notified to the Council's Community Environment Team on 020 8583 5070.
Condition : 12 - No soakaways shall be constructed in contaminated ground.
Condition : 13 - Prior to first occupation of the building a minimum of 25% reduction in carbon emissions shall be achieved in accordance with the approved Energy statements dated 04/02/2013.
Condition : 14 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the responsible sourcing of materials statement dated 11th January 2013.

Condition : 15 - Prior to occupation of the building the development shall be completed in accordance with the measures contained within the Rainwater Harvesting Statement.  The measures shall be thereafter maintained unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 16 - The access, car, cycle and HGV parking shall be provided as specified prior to the occupation of the development and thereafter retained for as long as the development remains in existence.

Condition : 17 - The measures contained in the Williams and Hill Delivery and Servicing Plan October 2013, received 21/10/2013, for Unit 1, shall be implemented for as long as the development remains in existence unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 18 - The measures contained in the Delivery and Servicing Plan for Unit 2 shall be implemented as approved in application 01321/N/P3(18) for as long as the development remains in existence unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 19 - The measures contained within the Construction Logistics Plan reference MS/T1292/01 rev 1 dated 28th January 2013 shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The development shall then be completed in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 20 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the BREEAM Interim (Design Stage) Certificate, issued by the Building Research Establishment (BRE) (or equivalent accredited body), approved in application 01321/N/P3(20) demonstrating that a minimum Very Good rating (aspiring to Excellent) will be achieved.

Condition : 21 - Within one month of first occupation of Unit 1, the LBH must be provided with evidence that the securing of a BREEAM Final Certificate demonstrating that a Very Good rating is achievable. Supporting evidence must include the BREEAM post-construction summary report submitted to BRE for the issue of certificate and letter of confirmation in writing from the BREEAM assessor confirming that this has been sent to the BRE. 

Within 4 months of practical completion of Unit 1, a BREEAM Final (Post-Construction) Certificate, issued by the BRE (or equivalent accredited body), must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that a Very Good rating has been achieved.

Condition : 22 - Within one month of first occupation of Unit 2, the LBH must be provided with evidence that the securing of a BREEAM Final Certificate demonstrating that a Very Good rating is achievable. Supporting evidence must include the BREEAM post-construction summary report submitted to BRE for the issue of certificate and letter of confirmation in writing from the BREEAM assessor confirming that this has been sent to the BRE. 

Within 4 months of practical completion of Unit 2, a BREEAM Final (Post-Construction) Certificate, issued by the BRE (or equivalent accredited body), must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that a Very Good rating has been achieved.

Condition : 23 - Prior to the occupation of the development the electric car charging points shall be provided as specified in the application and thereafter maintained in working order for as long as the development remains in existence.

Condition : 24 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved landscape details prior to the occupation of the development.  Any planting that dies or is seriously damaged within 5 years of the occupation of the development shall be replaced in accordance with the approved details.
description: Variation of conditions 2 (in accordance with the plans) 17 (servicing plan) and conditions 20, 21 and 22 (BREEAM Final (Post-Construction) Certificate and implementation) of planning permission 01321/N/P3 dated 08 February 2013
